steps.content: After Euphoria was destroyed, many Sinners were escorted back to the Bureau through the passage between FAC and MBCC.
As an S-class Sinner, Milly should have been among the first to be escorted back, but due to her physical condition, she was forced to remain for extensive treatment in the meantime.
She's a bubbly one. Only a few days after she woke up, the whole hospital knew about how hard she'd fallen for the Chief.
[Hospital Ward]

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: R-really? The one who saved me really was... the hero of DisCity.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I thought I was hallucinating before I died... Wait, does that mean he saw me looking like a total wreck?
steps.female_content: I thought I was hallucinating before I died... Wait, does that mean she saw me looking like a total wreck?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh no! I was hoping to make a perfect impression for our second meeting. Now that's completely out the window.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: It's okay. Even if you missed the first and second chances, there's always a third time, and a fourth.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Here you go, Miss Milly. Your photo. It was in the inner pocket of your coat, with all the other items under investigation. Almost got confiscated as evidence. I had to file several reports with Adjutant Nightingale to get it back for you.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh! Thank you! That's wonderful! I was so sure I lost it in the ruins.
She clutches the photo to her chest, a faint blush creeping up her deathly pale cheeks.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: On that ship, this photo was what kept me going. I looked at him every day, talked to him... hoping that one day, he'd show up again...
steps.female_content: On that ship, this photo was what kept me going. I looked at her every day, talked to her... hoping that one day, she'd show up again...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Now, just thinking that Chief is so close to me makes my heart race. It feels like a dream.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: You really adore Chief, don't you? Come on, time for your medicine. Once you get your strength back, you'll be your radiant self again. Chief will surely fall for you.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: How much longer will it take? I've been stuck in bed for... did you say it's been almost a week? What if Chief forgets about me?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: I'm sure that won't happen. But if you're that anxious, I can go file a request with Adjutant Nightingale right now. Ask Chief to come visit you?
The girl's face flushes bright red.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: N-no! Please don't! I haven't recovered yet! Look! My cast is still on! I can barely move, I-I haven't done my makeup in days, and I'm seriously behind on my skincare! I—cough cough...
She breaks into a coughing fit. The nurse hurries to help her catch her breath.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: So please don't! I'm not ready...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But... could you take this letter to Chief for me?
She carefully pulls a pink envelope from under her pillow.

steps.speaker: I remember too.
steps.content: Oooh... a love letter?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Please? I really need your help! But no peeks!

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Alright, I'll take it. But it might take a few days. I think Chief and the others are already on their way back to DisCity.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...Huh?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Something important came up, I think. But he made sure to arrange all of your follow-up treatment, accommodations, and transfer to the Bureau. He hopes you'll...
steps.female_content: Something important came up, I think. But she made sure to arrange all of your follow-up treatment, accommodations, and transfer to the Bureau. She hopes you'll...

steps.content: Milly doesn't hear the rest.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ${PlayerName} is leaving?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: No, I don't want this! ...cough...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I don't want to be left here all alone. I want to go with ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I've... waited so long to see him again.
steps.female_content: I've... waited so long to see her again.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I can't... I can't just wait here. I have to go see him!
steps.female_content: I can't... I can't just wait here. I have to go see her!

steps.content: Milly struggles to wriggle her legs over the side of the bed.
The monitors connected to her blare warnings, but she pays them no mind.
Crash!

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Miss Milly! You can't move around like that!
Hearing the alarms from the room, guards and doctors rush in. They restrain Milly, trying to get her back onto the bed.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: No... let me go! I, I need to see Chief...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Please, I'm begging you, don't let him leave me behind... Let me go with him...
steps.female_content: Please, I'm begging you, don't let her leave me behind... Let me go with her...

steps.content: As she struggles, a scent sweet as honey begins to emanate from her body.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Huff... huff... take me... take me to Chief, please. I'm begging you, please take me there!

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: ...Okay.
[Inside the Sand Ship]
On the landing pad, a massive sand ship is preparing for departure.
You lean against the window, watching the sand kicked up by the engines, when a flash of honey-gold catches your eye.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What's that?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Chief! Chief!!!
You can't believe it. There, on the landing pad, is Milly—who should be on bed rest—escorted by nurses and doctors.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Chief!!
You can't make out her words over the engine's roar. You only see her waving one arm frantically, the other encased in a cast and promptly pressed down by a doctor.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Nightingale... isn't that Milly? Why is she here?! She's supposed to be resting!
Is her Mania out of control again? Or is she still under the effects of mind control?
A wave of alarm overwhelms you. The lingering influence of the Black Ring sends a throbbing pain through your head, and your vision goes dark for a second.
Nightingale strides to the window, glances out, and presses her earpiece.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Landing pad security, report. An S-Class Sinner has been spotted on the landing pad. Is this an attack?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...? Really? She's calmed down?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood.
Nightingale ends the call.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Don't worry, Chief, she's not out of control. Milly... she heard you were returning to DisCity ahead of schedule while she was to remain here and rest. She couldn't accept it, so she came after us. They just reported that she's stabilizing now. She knows she can't catch up to the ship and has accepted the situation.
You sigh and rub your temples.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What we're heading into is too dangerous for her. She's been through enough. Now that she's free from Euphoria, I just want her to have some time to heal in peace.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I signed the paperwork for her transfer back to DisCity, didn't I?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. But it seems she ran off before she had a chance to see them. If you're worried, Chief, I can contact her again and reiterate the arrangements.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I'll see to it immediately.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You need to rest.
Nightingale gestures at the monitor beside you.

You glance over. The screen shows the erratic patterns of the Black Ring superimposed over your own vitals. The brief spike of agitation just now has triggered a bright red warning, a clear sign that you're in no condition to leave.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Right. Sorry, I'll leave it to you then.
[Outside the Sand Ship]

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: They... they're gone...
Milly slumps weakly to the ground.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Sob... why...
The guards have already surrounded her. But seeing the Chief's ship disappear into the distance, Milly has no fight left and lets them restrain her again.
One of the FAC soldiers walks up and activates a remote communication device.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: MBCC-S-459, Miss Milly. Your presence here violates the detention protocols we previously agreed upon. Technically, this qualifies as an escape attempt. The guards have every right to use force.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I don't care! Miss Nightingale, I want to see Chief! I want to go back to DisCity with him!
steps.female_content: I don't care! Miss Nightingale, I want to see Chief! I want to go back to DisCity with her!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief cannot see you right now. The BR-005 outbreak has severely compromised his health. He was already pushing himself to the limit to resolve the Euphoria incident. What Chief needs now is extensive rest and treatment. He's only leaving because circumstances have forced his hand.
steps.female_content: Chief cannot see you right now. The BR-005 outbreak has severely compromised her health. She was already pushing herself to the limit to resolve the Euphoria incident. What Chief needs now is extensive rest and treatment. She's only leaving because circumstances have forced her hand.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: What... ${PlayerName} is sick too?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: However, Chief understands how you feel and has made special arrangements for your return journey. I hope you won't let Chief down.
Nightingale deliberately emphasizes her last sentence. A staff member steps up and produces a travel document bearing the Chief's personal signature.
Milly takes it, stunned. She blushes as she traces her finger over the handwriting, caressing the name.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: This is... Chief personally...
She lets out a soft breath and presses the document to her heart.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Um...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: About Chief's illness... is it...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: If I don't disturb Chief, would the peaceful rest help with a faster recovery?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. And the same goes for you, of course.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I understand. The next time we meet, I'll be fully recovered. I won't make Chief worry about me again.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: B-but! Can I ask you to deliver this letter for me?
Finally, she carefully holds out a pink envelope.
[Scene change, screen dims]
My dear ${PlayerName},
I couldn't stop myself from writing to you again.

I'm not very good at writing. The person who taught me when I was a kid used to hit me, so I didn't like to write for a long, long time. But if I don't write, how else can I tell you how very, very much I love you?

I think about you all the time. The last time I saw you, your shirt had blood on it. Did someone wash it for you? I want to be with you so badly, to secretly wash the blood out of your shirts. I'm so jealous of whoever gets to do your laundry. Who could be so lucky, to always be by your side?
If I had the chance, I'd stay right by your side and never leave. I would wash all of your clothes and iron them perfectly. No one could do it better than me.

I look for you even in my dreams. But I don't know where to find you. The place I go the most is the place we last saw each other, but I know I'll never see you there again, even though that place hasn't changed at all in my dreams.

I'm begging fate to give me one chance to see you again. I know you hold me in your heart, too. I'll seize that chance with everything I have, and I'll show you how much I love you. I can be the perfect lover for you.
My love, may this letter carry to you a million of my silent kisses.
